about: Look family co-occurrence over the 2,128 corpus builds. build_lift = P(both in a build) / (P(A) P(B)). same_area_rate = share of the builds that have both families under cover where a piece of each stands within 4 m and 1.5 m height of the other. area_lift = same_area_rate / the median rate over all pairs with 20 or more such builds. Furniture and decor families only (no building pieces, plants, food); shell_families gives build_lift for building-piece families.
